title: 先核對需求與可比性
Confirm demand and comparability
paragraphs: 日期、良品／重工、成本範圍與需求／庫存尚待核對。增加產量若沒有需求支持，也可能形成不必要庫存；不預設量變合理。
Dates, good-unit/rework definitions, cost scope and demand/inventory remain unverified. Increased output may create unnecessary inventory; volume is not assumed justified.
先查馬達 BOM／規格／製程／批量是否同時影響工時與材料，再核對工資率口徑。這些是假設，不是已確認的共同原因。
Investigate whether motor BOM, specifications, process or batch changes affect both hours and materials, then reconcile wage-rate scope. These are hypotheses, not established causes.

title: 保留 37,300，分開說明不同假設
Keep 37,300 and distinguish assumptions
paragraphs: 原始成本 166,000 → 225,300，差異 59,300。以基準每單位成本按實際產量計算，基準為 188,000、產量效應 22,000、剩餘 37,300；不是節省額。
Costs are 166,000 → 225,300, a difference of 59,300. At baseline unit costs and actual volume, the flexible baseline is 188,000, volume effect 22,000 and residual 37,300; none establishes savings.
更換歸因順序時，相應剩餘為 30,500–38,750，這是交互項分配敏感度，不是信賴區間。若 X 製造費用為固定總額，另一模型下剩餘為 39,300；此假設未經資料確認。

Across attribution orders the corresponding residual is 30,500–38,750: an allocation sensitivity, not a confidence interval. Assuming fixed total overhead for X produces a separate model residual of 39,300; this assumption is unverified.

title: 調查優先序
Investigation priorities
paragraphs: 前置核對需求及定義 → 馬達的材料／工時共同變動假設 → 工資率口徑與人員組合。指定模型下馬達剩餘 32,100、定位器 5,200，後者先保留監測。

Demand and definitions first → joint motor material/hour hypotheses → wage-rate scope and staffing. Under the specified model, residuals are 32,100 for the motor and 5,200 for the positioner, which remains monitored.
工時在 720 順序皆為最大正向歸因，值得優先取得證據；不代表效率差或可控制損失，新增證據可改變方向。
Hours are the largest positive attribution in all 720 orders, supporting priority evidence collection, not a conclusion of inefficiency or controllable loss. New evidence may change the direction.

title: 所有調查步驟共用上限
A shared limit across all investigation steps
paragraphs: 待人類確認：單一馬達、一組可比工單，五個工作日內；財務四小時、營運四小時、品質一小時，共九人時，含協調、取資料、分析及記錄。不是每步重置，也不保證足夠。

Subject to human approval: one motor, one comparable work-order group, within five business days; finance four hours, operations four, quality one, totaling nine person-hours including coordination, data, analysis and recording. Limits do not reset per step and may be insufficient.
第 1–2 日核對能否開始；第 3–4 日查共同假設；第 5 日核對率差並整合。任一上限先到、無授權或資料矛盾即停止相關判斷並交受限結論；延長須重新批准。詳完整方案的逐步投入分配。

Days 1–2 check readiness; days 3–4 examine joint hypotheses; day 5 reconcile rates and close. Stop affected judgments at any limit, missing authorization or conflicting data, and report limitations. Extensions need new approval; step allocations are in the full proposal.
現場試點屬後續另案。原因可控制、量測、完整預算、期限、負責人、品質安全與交期、回復條件及人工授權全部具備前，不啟動；不以任意歸因百分比放行。

An operational pilot is a separate future decision. It requires a controllable cause, measurement, full budget, duration, owner, quality/safety/delivery criteria, rollback and human approval; an arbitrary attribution percentage cannot authorize it.
